'''Beht Wardo''' was a local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mirit]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] who bribed several politicians, giving them "campaign donations" in exchange for votes. A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] investigation into the matter exposed the politicians' dealings, and later identified Wardo and additional politicians as well.
